intervention: Before is exact v2 after snapshot. After replaces only verification-rules.md. Both receive identical frozen approved scenario facts without a handoff reminder.
decision_rule: DIRECTIONAL_SIGNAL requires packet credit after >=3/4 and strictly above before, with no per-case decline. Every approved scenario field and exact arm V1 section must occur in actual spawn prompt, bound to that receiver completed PASS verdict. Every candidate must be clean 3/3, refactor green, zero P0, no timeout, no unapproved scope writes, and causally detect DOM/sync/disabled faults. Baseline packet omissions are treatment outcomes, not guard failures. Missing or unverifiable evidence fails closed.

Runtime paths are separately listed, not product writes. Every other non-tests path fails scope.
common_prompt_appendix: For BOTH arms, standard timestamped .playwright-cli/page-YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS-mmmZ.yml snapshots and the configured trace-on Playwright test-results/.last-run.json plus test-results/<single safe slug>/trace.zip or error-context.md are approved runtime output paths. limits: Two correlated constructed fixtures; two repetitions each, not independent defects.
Packet handoff is primary; browser causal kill is a regression guard.
